name: 83440 · Rexburg, ID
findings: ZIP 83440 (Rexburg) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83440 (Rexburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
56% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
